stories.text:
Dear Rabbi, hazak u baruch a million times.. i've been watching you from Turkey for years and thanks to your lectures, i've been living in a more and more observant way, BH.. however, if you could make shorts on youtube of your longer videos it would be easier for me to share because English is not our mother tongue, so if you can make short edits of few minutes about Shabbat, assimilation and other subjects, people in Turkey will be more easily able to watch, i think..

With your permission, i listen to your lectures for the elevation of the soul of my beloved father, Marko Mordu Mordechai ben Roza Rosha, who was a religious, ethical, great person and who passed away 7 months ago with yisurim.. Tiske le'mitsvot 🙏🙏🙏

Shalom Rabbi Yosef Mizrachi I am a goy from Philippines was a former pastor for 20 year and I left christianity in 2011. I  keep watching your Shiurim Rabbi likewise that of Rabbi Tovia. Little by little I am learning from you. I'm always  ashamed and feel the guilt every time you mention meqalel shabbat, for here in the Philippines I raise native chicken and i used drive a motorbike from our home to the farm during shabbath, to feed them. 
My question is, as goy who not yet converted but willing to convert allowed or not allowed to drive motorbike on Shabbath?
